title: Refresh README + docs narrative after sutra_orient deletion
description:
sutra/312 deleted the sutra_orient tool but scoped its doc cleanup to help recipes, tools_meta, conventions-map.md, and code doc-comments. Several live docs still advertise orient and need a coherent refresh — deferred because rewriting them is editorial/narrative judgment, not mechanical deletion, and the product's "core loop" framing is built around orient.

Live-doc references still present (verified via rg 'orient' after the deletion commit b5952ba):
- README.md: the core-loop line "explore → orient → check → review → teach" (line ~9), the sutra_orient tool-table row (~224), the surfacing paragraph naming sutra_orient (~202), the observed-patterns description (~47), and the example (~269). Deciding how to describe the loop WITHOUT orient is a product-identity call, not a find/replace.
- docs/health-map.md and docs/constraints-map.md: describe orient's health/constraints sections as current architecture (health-map ~23/99/148/359/374; constraints-map ~73/116/139/392/653/677).
- docs/sutra-understand-design.md, docs/sutra-vision.md: orient as a designed surface. NOTE: much of docs/reviews/* and docs/archived/* are point-in-time records — do NOT revise those (revisionism); only refresh docs describing the CURRENT tool inventory/architecture.

Separately: conventions-map.md is also stale vs sutra/313 (still documents the removed FCA deviation review report). Worth folding a 313 doc-refresh into the same pass.
execution_record:
Landed in 3 commits (35dd54a maps, 12d1ebe README, 612119f vision docs). Josh's product-identity calls: Fork 1=A (core loop → four beats: explore → check → review → teach; orient's briefing role absorbed into contextual lesson/convention surfacing at read time). Fork 2=A (Layer 2 conventions reframed as honest list-only via sutra_conventions; detection still runs, both in-loop consumers retired). Fork 3=A light-touch (vision docs are planning not canonical — added status-note banner to each rather than rewriting aspirational content).

Delivered: README (core loop, Layer 2 §3, dropped retired [conventions] rules.toml block + sutra_orient tool row + Orient-before-editing workflow + all deviation refs; tool count corrected 37→31, which had drifted independently of this change); conventions-map.md rewritten to list-only reality; constraints-map.md + health-map.md orient refs removed from current-arch prose with historical task-ledger rows annotated not erased; status banners on sutra-vision/understand-design/writing-side.

Deferred to sutra/318 (product decisions beyond mechanical cleanup, deliberately not done unilaterally): CONTEXT.md still models "Orient" as a canonical core-loop concept (contradicts the new README loop); sketch mode / ADR-0001 may now be vestigial for conventions. CONTEXT.md left untouched pending that call — it's canonical, not a planning doc, so the vision-doc banner approach doesn't fit.

Verification: docs-only change, no test surface. Verified by targeted grep sweeps that README + the 3 maps carry no stale current-architecture orient/deviation refs (remaining hits are intentional changelog prose and strikethrough historical ledger rows). Full workspace cargo test was green at the start of this session (1545 passed) from the 312/313 review and is untouched by doc edits.
